code='''def transform(grid):
 g=[r[:] for r in grid]; h=len(g); w=max(map(len,g));
 for r in g:
  r.extend([0]*(w-len(r)))
 colors={v for r in g for v in r if v not in (0,)}
 # background is most common nonzero color; all other colors are connected by rectangular outlines
 from collections import Counter
 bg=Counter(v for r in g for v in r if v).most_common(1)[0][0]
 for c in colors-{bg}:
  pts=[(y,x) for y in range(h) for x in range(w) if g[y][x]==c]
  if not pts: continue
  y0=min(y for y,x in pts); y1=max(y for y,x in pts); x0=min(x for y,x in pts); x1=max(x for y,x in pts)
  for x in range(x0,x1+1):
   if g[y0][x]==0:g[y0][x]=c
   if g[y1][x]==0:g[y1][x]=c
  for y in range(y0,y1+1):
   if g[y][x0]==0:g[y][x0]=c
   if g[y][x1]==0:g[y][x1]=c
 return g
'''
